verdict.rationale: E2B is fundamentally API/SDK-first: sandbox creation, filesystem, commands, metrics, and templates are all exposed via SDK and mirrored in the CLI (e2b-docs-9, e2b-docs-18, probe-4), with no evidence of a GUI-only feature lacking an API/CLI equivalent. The dashboard appears to be a monitoring layer over the same API-driven primitives rather than a distinct control surface.
